author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Lowe goes deep Thursday
desc: Brandon Lowe went 2-for-4 with a home run in the Pirates 5-1 win over the Mariners on Thursday.
impact: Lowe got the scoring going early with a solo blast in the first inning off Brandon Lowe. It was his 19th home run on the season and fifth in June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Henry Davis hits home run Thursday
desc: Henry Davis went 2-for-3 with a home run in the Pirates 5-1 win over the Mariners on Thursday.
impact: Davis extended the Pirates lead to 3-0 with a two-run long ball off Bryce Miller. He also stole his second base of the season.  He is still slashing just .148/.247/.319 on the year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bubba Chandler earns win Thursday
desc: Bubba Chandler allowed one run on five hits over 5 1/3 innings with four strikeouts and three walks in a win on Thursday against the Mariners.
impact: Chandler posted one of his better recent outings against a struggling Seattle lineup. He did not struggle with his command outside of the fifth inning when he walked back-to-back hitters, but he escaped the frame allowing just one run. He'll face the Phillies next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryce Miller strikes out 11 in loss Thursday
desc: Bryce Miller allowed three runs on five hits over 5 2/3 innings with 11 strikeouts in a loss on Thursday against the Pirates.
impact: Miller allowed a pair of home runs for the three runs he allowed. The Mariners offense scored three runs or less for the 11th straight game so as soon as he allowed those three runs, it was an uphill battle for Seattle to win the game. Miller did his job with 11 strikeouts and pitching into the sixth inning. He'll carry a strong 1.97 ERA into his next start against the Angels.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ali Sanchez to return to Yankees Friday
desc: Ali Sanchez is expected to be activated from the paternity list on Friday.
impact: Sanchez has been away for a few days. J.C. Escarra was optioned to Triple-A on Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.C. Escarra optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Yankees optioned C J.C. Escarra to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre.
impact: Escarra will return to Triple-A with Ali Sánchez expected to be activated from the paternity list on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zak Kent expected to be recalled Friday
desc: Zak Kent is expected to be recalled from Triple-A Rochester on Friday.
impact: Washington optioned Gus Varland to Triple-A on Thursday. He'll hold a middle-relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gus Varland optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Nationals optioned RHP Gus Varland to Triple-A Rochester.
impact: Varland struggled during his appearance on Thursday. He will return to Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Sanchez released by Royals
desc: The Royals released RHP Aaron Sanchez.
impact: Sanchez will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Jackson released by Royals
desc: The Royals released RHP Luke Jackson.
impact: Jackson had been on a minor league contract with Kansas City. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dillon Tate signs minor league deal with Angels
desc: The Angels signed RHP Dillon Tate to a minor league contract.
impact: Tate will report to the team's spring training complex in Arizona where he'll build up. He could be an option in the majors later in the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Susac suffers back injury Thursday
desc: Daniel Susac was removed from Thursday afternoon's game against the Athletics due to tightness in his back.
impact: Susac is considered day-to-day heading into the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christopher Morel sent outright by Marlins
desc: The Marlins sent 1B/OF Christopher Morel outright to Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Morel was designated for assignment and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Marlins organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sammy Peralta sent outright by Rockles
desc: The Rockies sent LHP Sammy Peralta outright to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Peralta was designated for assignment and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Rockies organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Solak sent outright by Padres
desc: The Padres sent INF/OF Nick Solak outright to Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Solak was designated for assignment and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Padres organization.
